description: Litter is read-only. The database server was seized during an FBI raid, so every write path is permanently gone: uploads, chunked uploads, E2EE, deletion, reporting, translation and Git LFS no longer exist. The 383,528 files that were already stored are still served from Telegram. Files over 20 MB return 413 — Telegram's Bot API will not hand them over.

/files/:id/:filename.description: Download or stream a file. Supports Range requests.

parameters.id: string - Public ID (6-24 chars) or legacy numeric Telegram message ID
parameters.filename: string (optional) - Ignored; the stored filename is always used

success.body: Binary file content with Content-Type, Content-Disposition and X-Litter-Message-Id headers

partial.body: Partial content when Range header is provided. Range requests bypass the cache.

errors.404: File not found. A numeric ID missing from the index is retried against the Telegram group before this is returned.
errors.413: File is over Telegram's 20 MB bot download limit and cannot be served over HTTP. The response is an HTML page carrying the Telegram message ID. 196 files are affected.
errors.502: Telegram was unreachable or the stored message is gone

/files/:id.description: Download a file without a filename in the path. Identical behaviour.

parameters.id: string - Public ID or legacy numeric Telegram message ID

body.webServable: boolean — false when the file is over the 20 MB bot limit
body.indexed: boolean — false when the row was missing from the index and had to be resolved from the Telegram group; uploadDate is null in that case

/api/info/:id.notes: sha256, md5, ocrText and the NSFW fields are gone — they lived only in the seized database.

/api/info/:id/:filename.description: Same as /api/info/:id. The filename is ignored.

/api/get/:id.description: Redirects 301 to /files/:messageId/:filename. Discord's unfurler is served the bytes inline instead, so embeds still resolve.

/api/view/:id.description: Serves the bytes directly, same as /files/:id.

removed.description: These endpoints existed before the raid and now return 410 Gone. There is no replacement; nothing here accepts writes.
removed.methods: Any request that is not GET or HEAD returns 410 regardless of path.
